landing.main.subtitle: Get a course you'll definitely complete
landing.main.title: ACG generates courses based on your goals and experience
landing.main.cases.first.description: Based on your experience, ACG will generate a course that will provide the necessary knowledge to achieve your goal
landing.main.cases.second.description: Consolidate your knowledge by completing advanced practice exercises that will prepare you for real work tasks
landing.main.cases.third.description: Receive support from a mentor-chatbot during the course and practical tasks. Based on your questions and results, ACG will adapt the next material.
landing.main.howItWorks.first.title: Consult with the mentor-chatbot.
landing.main.howItWorks.first.descriptio: Say what you want to learn, your background and the goal you want to achieve
landing.main.howItWorks.second.title: Get a customized study plan
landing.main.howItWorks.second.descripti: Receive a study plan based on your preferences and actual topics for study
landing.main.howItWorks.third.title: Learn topics through video and text.
landing.main.howItWorks.third.descriptio: At each stage, you will have access to the most relevant articles and videos for your studies
landing.main.howItWorks.fourth.title: Mentor support
landing.main.howItWorks.fourth.descripti: Receive answers to questions that arise during the course from a chatbot mentor
landing.main.howItWorks.fifth.title: Practical task
landing.main.howItWorks.fifth.descriptio: Complete challenging practical task along the whole course
landing.main.mission.first.paragraph.sec: and assist individuals in achieving educational goals through accessible, effective, and engaging learning experiences.
landing.main.mission.second.paragraph.se: an innovative platform for personalized education, simplifying access to relevant materials and promoting self-development for everyone, regardless of experience or opportunities.
landing.main.form.paragraph: Become a part of the ACG community and gain access to personalized learning like never before. Sign up now to start your journey toward knowledge, growth, and success.
